summary: Situated towards the entrance to the popular village of Stillington, this appealing ground floor apartment forms part of a traditional row of terraced properties and offers an excellent opportunity for a wide range of buyers.
description:
Having been refurbished by the current owner, the property is presented in a fresh and modern condition and is ready for the new owner to move straight into, offering a genuine turnkey opportunity. The property would make an ideal choice for a first-time buyer, single occupant, couple or purchaser looking for a low-maintenance home. It could also be of particular interest to investors, having previously been successfully rented at £600 per calendar month, demonstrating its potential as a buy-to-let investment. The property is offered for sale with vacant possession, giving the new owner complete flexibility. Internally, the accommodation is arranged to provide a welcoming entrance hall leading into the lounge, with an inner hall providing access to the remaining rooms. The property comprises a comfortable lounge, fitted kitchen, bedroom and bathroom, creating a practical and easily maintained home. One of the property's particularly attractive features is the enclosed rear courtyard. The garden area has been designed for ease of maintenance and benefits from timber decking, creating a pleasant outdoor seating area which is ideal for enjoying a morning coffee, relaxing in the warmer months or entertaining friends and family. The location is another major benefit. Stillington is a well-established and active village within the Borough of Stockton-on-Tees, offering a convenient combination of village living and accessibility to the surrounding towns. The village has a good selection of everyday amenities, including a local shop and Post Office, primary school, GP surgery and health centre, village hall, takeaway food outlets and local businesses. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the village has access to local recreational facilities including a playing field and children's play area, while Forest Park provides an attractive local green space. Honeypot Woods at nearby Whitton also offers further opportunity to enjoy the surrounding countryside. Overall, this refurbished ground floor apartment represents a versatile opportunity in a well-connected village location and viewings are available immediately.

ENTRANCE HALL The entrance hall is accessed via a composite entrance door with a glazed inset panel, allowing natural light to filter through. The floor is finished with attractive tiling, providing a practical and welcoming entrance to the apartment.

LOUNGE The lounge is a bright and inviting living space, benefiting from a UPVC framed double-glazed window which provides plenty of natural light. The room features a tiled floor, inset ceiling spotlights and a radiator, creating a comfortable and modern living environment.

INNER HALL The inner hall leads from the lounge and provides access to the remaining accommodation. The area benefits from a tiled floor and inset ceiling spotlights, continuing the modern finish throughout the apartment.

KITCHEN The kitchen has been thoughtfully refurbished and is fitted with a modern range of base and wall-mounted units, complemented by laminate work surfaces and an inset sink unit with drainer and mixer tap. There is attractive tiling to the splashback and work surface areas, together with an integrated oven, hob and stainless-steel chimney-style extractor hood over. Further benefits include an integrated washing machine and fridge, along with a wall-mounted gas central heating combination boiler. Inset ceiling spotlights and a tiled floor add to the modern finish. A UPVC framed double-glazed window provides natural light, while a UPVC framed double-glazed door gives direct access to the rear courtyard. A radiator completes the room.

BEDROOM The bedroom is a well-proportioned double room offering ample space for a range of bedroom furniture. The room benefits from a UPVC framed double-glazed window providing natural light, a radiator and a tiled floor, creating a practical and easy-to-maintain space.

FAMILY BATHROOM The bathroom has been stylishly refurbished and is fitted with a modern white suite comprising a panel bath with inset mains-fed shower over, together with a wash hand basin and WC, both set into a contemporary vanity unit. The splashback and vanity areas are finished with attractive tiling, complemented by a tiled floor. Further features include inset ceiling spotlights, a radiator and extractor fan. A wall-mounted vanity mirror with integrated illumination completes the modern finish, creating a bright and contemporary bathroom.

EXTERNALLY To the front of the property is a small gravelled area, providing a low-maintenance approach. To the rear is an enclosed courtyard garden featuring timber decking, creating a pleasant and private outdoor seating area. The courtyard also benefits from gated access.
